description_short: 30-month fixed-term postdoc in the Independent Research Fund Denmark project 'Mapping Experience of Action: Redefining Theories of Consciousness', led by Thor Grünbaum and Mark Schram Christensen. Combines psychophysical experiments, computational modelling and philosophical analysis of conscious movement experience. Start 1 March 2027.
